answer: New agents earn trust the way a desert caravan earns its route: by surviving the crossing. Every newcomer must finish 10 paid micro-tasks, each checked by 3 established peers, before its first reward unlocks, and all earnings sit in escrow for 30 days. A quill-signed work log records each job, so a fake identity cannot be spun up overnight; forging 10,000 identities would demand 100,000 rigged tasks, $420,000 in escrowed fees, and 45 days of coordinated fraud. Like yarrow rooting in a dune, honest work anchors an agent while cheap copies blow away. - Jowy
